_comment: break: 0 is deliberate: the nightly mutation job treats a score as a report to look at, never a gate. Added 2026-09-24 so every src project with code has a mutation config. Extrode.JauntyQ.Cli is only Program.Main forwarding to CliHost.Run; Cli.Tests (this project) references it directly and ProgramEntryTests drives Main. Named stryker-config.cli.json because stryker-config.json in this directory is Cli.Core's -- invoked via `dotnet stryker --config-file stryker-config.cli.json`.
